messages.subject: INLA keeps on crashing
parts:
I run this code:
#Setup INLA Output
control <- list(
  predictor = list(compute=T,link=1),
  result = list(return.marginals.random=T,
                return.marginals.predictor=T),
  compute = list(hyperpar=T,return.marginals=T,
                 dic=T,mlik=T,cpo=T,po=T,waic=T,
                 graph=T,openmp.strategy="huge"))
#Setup model Besag
ModelBesag <- DBD~f(id,model="besag",graph=Ws,constr=T)+RW+Ketinggian+Durasi

ModelBayBesag <- inla(ModelBesag,family="poisson",data=Data,
                      control.compute=control$compute,
                      control.predictor=control$predictor,
                      control.inla=list(tolerance=1e-20,h=1e-8,int.strategy="eb",
                                        strategy="simplified.laplace"))


But it always error. This the error message:
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

 *** inla.core.safe:  inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=1/2

 *** inla.core.safe:  rerun with improved initial values
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

What should I do?
